 CEDAR RAPIDS, Iowa (Iowa's News Now) — A storage unit is heavily damaged after a fire in Cedar Rapids Tuesday night. 
 The Cedar Rapids Fire Department responded to the unit in the 2800 block of 16th Avenue SW around 11:30 p.m.
 Firefighters arrived to heavy flames and smoke coming from the storage unit. The fire was quickly put out. 
 There was heavy fire damage to the unit with smoke damaging multiple nearby units. 
 No one was hurt and the cause of the fire is under investigation.
